news.title: Cherokee deputy fired after allegedly using fake Facebook to target man
news.summary: A Cherokee County sheriff's deputy has been fired after an internal investigation found he created a fake social media account to target a man he previously arrested, according to authorities.

news.title: Jury acquits ex-deputy in shooting death of Airman from Atlanta

news.title: Driver crashes into police escort carrying SWAT vehicle
news.summary: Two people were taken to the hospital Friday morning after a crash involving a Clayton County police SWAT vehicle in Spalding County.

news.title: Stone Mountain man gets life without parole in fatal Lilburn shooting
news.summary: The shooting killed Tigist Lulesegud, 57, and injured her 65-year-old brother, Abebe D. Yeshetela.

news.title: ‘He was supposed to be coming home’: Family demands answers in jail death

news.summary: The children of a man fatally stabbed in Atlanta are suing, claiming civil liability in his wrongful-death case.

news.title: 'Painful moment,' attorney says, as Florida deputy found not guilty in 2024 shooting of US airman from metro Atlanta
news.summary: Attorney Ben Crump issued a statement on the verdict Friday in the case involving the deadly shooting of Roger Fortson in May 2024.

news.title: Fifth suspect arrested in Atlanta bartender’s killing
news.summary: Jacob Benjamin Wilson, 30, was arrested Wednesday on charges of concealing a death and tampering with evidence in the Jamal Parker case.

news.title: DeKalb announces Blackhall lawsuit, South Fulton has new chief
